description: This line plot illustrates the similarity of Hidden State Activations (HSAs) across four language pairs—'en&en' (red), 'en&es' (blue), 'en&el' (green), and 'en&bn' (pink)—as a function of layer within the Qwen1.5-1.8B model, with the horizontal axis representing layer number ranging from 0 to 24 and the vertical axis representing similarity ranging from 0.00 to 0.45. The red line ('en&en') begins at approximately 0.07 at layer 0, rises to a peak of 0.26 at layer 6, then declines to 0.08 at layer 20 before sharply increasing to 0.43 at layer 23. The blue line ('en&es') starts at 0.06 at layer 0, peaks at 0.24 at layer 6, and then stabilizes around 0.06 from layer 20 onward, showing no significant increase. The green line ('en&el') and pink line ('en&bn') both start at 0.04 and 0.03 respectively, peak at 0.15 and 0.13 at layer 6, and then decline to 0.05 at layer 20 before rising to 0.30 at layer 23. Notably, the similarity for 'en&es' consistently exceeds that of 'en&en' across layers 6 to 20, contrary to expectations.
caption_used: The similarity of HSAs in different languages across all layers within Qwen1.5-1.8B is depicted. The line plot shows four language pairs: 'en&en' (red), 'en&es' (blue), 'en&el' (green), and 'en&bn' (pink). The horizontal axis represents the layers, ranging from 0 to 24, while the vertical axis indicates similarity, ranging from 0.00 to 0.45. The red line starts at approximately 0.07 at layer 0, peaks at layer 6 with a value of 0.26, and then declines steadily to 0.08 at layer 20 before sharply increasing to 0.43 at layer 23. The blue line begins at 0.06 at layer 0, peaks at layer 6 with a value of 0.24, and then stabilizes around 0.06 from layer 20 onward, showing no significant increase. The green and pink lines exhibit similar trends, starting at 0.04 and 0.03 respectively, peaking at layer 6 with values of 0.15 and 0.13, and then declining to 0.05 at layer 20 before increasing to 0.3 at layer 23. Notably, the similarity between 'en&es' consistently exceeds that of 'en&en' across layers 6 to 20, contrary to expectations.
